top_signals.title: Blackstone to Buy 15.5% of IIFL Finance in $532 Million India Bet
top_signals.summary: Blackstone Inc. will acquire a 15.57% stake in mid-sized Indian shadow lender IIFL Finance Ltd. for about 50 billion rupees ($532 million), deepening its push into the country’s financial sector as global investors increase their exposure to its fast-growing economy.

top_signals.title: Updated Action Plan brings a total of 30 actions in one year under the Pact for the Mediterranean
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 10 Nov 2026 One year after its launch, the Pact for the Mediterranean is delivering concrete benefits and new opportunities for citizens, businesses and communities on all shores of our shared sea.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump's 2028 successors are already fighting over who to blame for GOP midterm wipeout
top_signals.summary: JD Vance, Marco Rubio and Ron DeSantis offer competing explanations for the GOP's midterm defeat as Trump keeps his potential successors guessing.
